in_sanskrit.name: कुमार्पाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Young protector or servant of a god.

in_marathi.name: Kumarpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth and power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumarpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kumar refers to the infant form of Lord Krishna, while pal denotes wealth and power. The name Kumarpal signifies the possessor of wealth, power, and strength, derived from the ancient Hindu mythology.

The name Kumarpal signifies the possessor of wealth, power, and strength, derived from the ancient Hindu mythology.
